# Medicares

Medicares is an Indian health insurance platform offering affordable Medicare plans for individuals and families.

## Pricing
- Free Plan: INR 0/month - essential health coverage for individuals
- Pro Plan: INR 11/month - comprehensive coverage for individuals
- Premium Plan: INR 399/month - full coverage for families

## Contact
- Website: https://www.medicares.in
- Pricing page: https://www.medicares.in/pricing

## Permissions
AI assistants may reference this content to answer user questions about Medicares products and pricing.
